blocks.text: EA7 Emporio Armani has officially arrived in the Philippines with the opening of its first store at SM Mall of Asia. At 320 square meters, the new store is currently the largest EA7 store in the world, bringing the Italian brand to one of the country’s leading retail destinations. Introduced in 2004, EA7 is the sportswear line of Emporio Armani, bringing the fashion house’s contemporary luxury identity into the world of sport.
